messages:
marta: Heads-up — planning a gentle traffic tilt to the new eu-west-edge nodes tonight 21:00 UTC. Target: 15% weighted traffic for 30m, then evaluate. Will coordinate DNS TTL drop + routing policy update.
ash: ack. Which routes are we changing?
marta: We'll add a new weighted rule in TrafficRouter: route-prefix /gen to eu-west-edge weight 15, fallback to origin. DNS TTL to 30s for the domain used by clients.
pranav: Oncall here — I can watch metrics. What smoke checks do we want?
lia: Quick list: 1) p95 latency < 1200ms for eu edge, 2) 5xx < 0.5% delta vs baseline, 3) KV cache hit rate not dropping >10%, 4) no surge of retry storms in logs.
samir: infra note: eu-west-edge autoscale policy has min=2 max=20, warm pool 2. Instance spins are ~90s so give us time.
marta: plan: TTL drop at 20:40 UTC, routing rule flip at 21:00, monitor 21:00-21:30, then increase to 30% if green at 21:45. Rollback plan: revert routing weight to 0 and restore TTL to 300s.
ash: I'll prepare the TrafficRouter change PR and link it here. Also will set a deploy-bot rollback tag.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled by ash at 21:00 UTC to traffic-router-service (sha: b7f4a2). Canary weight=15. Auto-rollback disabled (manual only).
pranav: I'll be by the pager. If p95 > 1500ms or 5xx spike >1% I will trigger rollback.
lia: Add a quick smoke script: curl 100 requests to /gen with keepalive, measure errors and latency. I'll run from eu test runner.
samir: Also watch Redis latency — if redis p50 > 10ms we might hit cache churn.
marta: good catches. Ash — can you post the exact TrafficRouter CLI command you'll run?
ash: sure:
```
trctl update-policy --name eu-tilt-2026 --add-route 'prefix=/gen;dest=eu-west-edge;weight=15' --ttl 30
```
I'll run in dry-run first, then apply.
marta: any routing ACLs we need to be mindful of?
samir: healthchecks are fine; backend pools already allow eu-edge. Only caveat is gzip offloading differs but should be harmless.
pranav: If we see client errors tied to region, call it out in channel and escalate to marta.
marta: OK team — execute timeline, post status updates in this thread. If green at 21:35 I'll update the rollout doc to proceed to +30%. :thumbsup:
ash: PR: github.com/redwood/tr/pull/482 — contains policy + smoke verification commands. Dry-run at 20:55.
lia: I'll kick off smoke runner at 21:05 and post results.
deploy-bot: action: dry-run completed by ash at 20:56 UTC. No errors.
pranav: 21:02 — first runner starting.
marta: thanks — keep it concise here. If rollback happens, use /pager escalate and tag infra-oncall.
ash: applying at 21:00 now.
deploy-bot: policy applied at 21:00 UTC. Weight=15.
lia: smoke results at 21:08: 100 reqs -> 0.0% 5xx, p95 480ms, cache hit delta +1%.
pranav: monitoring looks clean. No retry storms.
marta: green. Hold for 30m then we decide next step.
ash: noted. I'll wait for the +30% go/no-go.
samir: I'll watch host metrics and pre-warm if we need more capacity.
marta: great work everyone. I'll update the rollout doc after the 21:30 check-in.
